title: Harbinger on-prem weekly: deployment runway notes
body:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly sync with Harbinger STS (technical + program). Use this as the running agenda + action tracker between meetings.

Meeting cadence: weekly 30m, Tue 10:00 PT. Customer PM: Ravi Menon. Goal for next 4 weeks: complete VPC peering, finalize cert rotation approach, finish node image bake and smoke tests, and reach pilot readiness (limited traffic).

High-level status (current):
- Networking: VPC peering established but intermittent route flaps reported by customer (NET-88).
- Cluster: k8s 1.27 cluster provisioned in customer VPC; control plane healthy.
- Images & artifacts: base inference image tag v2026.02.18 baked; missing nvidia driver compatibility test on A100v5 nodes.
- Storage: NFS mount step validated in dev; customer will provide production NFS details this week.
- Security: KMS integration prototype complete; HSM review scheduled with security next Thu.

Key milestones (short runway):
- M1 (Mar 18): Resolve peering flaps + stable egress testing (slo: <50ms hop). Owner: Aman Iqbal.
- M2 (Mar 25): Bake final node image with driver + quant libs; run smoke-generation. Owner: Priya Kaur.
- M3 (Apr 1): Cert rotation policy and KMS integration sign-off. Owner: Sofia Park.
- M4 (Apr 8): Pilot start (10 TPS, canary model). Owner: Ravi Menon (customer) + Redwood eng on-call.

Open technical blockers (priority order):
1) Intermittent BGP/route flaps between Harbinger transit and customer VPCs (seen 2026-03-08). Impact: packet loss spikes causing sometimes >2s cold-start latencies. Next step: capture BGP logs and nettrace during incident window. Action: Ravi to grant temporary read access to their transit VPC logs; Aman to provide packet-capture runbook. (JIRA NET-88)

2) Driver mismatch on A100v5 flavor during inference startup causing CUDA init error in 5% of containers. Impact: failed pods during scale tests. Next: reproduce locally on a mirrored node image and validate driver/ML libs ordering. Action: Priya to create a reproducible container image and attach logs to DEPLOY-321. ETA: Mar 12.

3) NFS throughput tuning: 95th percentile latency on larger embeddings (>1k dims) is higher than acceptable. Customer to provide production NFS mount and throughput targets; Redwood to provide recommended mount options & fio profile. Action: Sofia to send recommended fio/hints doc by Mar 13.

4) Cert rotation: A concern around short-lived cert expiry in long-running kv-cache flows. Need to agree rotation grace period and refresh logic. Action: Security review scheduled (Mar 12). Owner: Sofia.

Meeting agenda draft (30m):
- 0-5m: Quick status (Sofia)
- 5-12m: Networking deep-dive (Aman + Ravi) — share last incident traces
- 12-20m: Image/driver status & smoke test results (Priya)
- 20-26m: Cert/KMS update and sign-off risks (Sofia + Security)
- 26-30m: Blockers & action review; set owners + due dates

Notes for convo / talking points:
- Ask the customer to identify a single network engineer point-of-contact for route incidents (helps debug flaps quickly).
- Offer a short window of co-debug with Redwood infra (3-hour block) next Tue morning — propose Aman + Alex Hwang (SRE) join.
- Clarify whether Harbinger wants host-managed drivers vs. container-managed drivers for GPU nodes (tradeoffs: node restart cadence vs container portability).

Action items (running):
- A1: Aman — produce BGP capture runbook + initial packet capture by Mar 11. (status: in_progress)
- A2: Priya — reproduce CUDA init error and attach logs to DEPLOY-321; propose mitigation (defer driver update or init-probe). Due Mar 12. (status: in_progress)
- A3: Sofia — send NFS fio profile and recommended mount flags; include sample systemd mount unit for reliability. Due Mar 13. (status: todo)
- A4: Ravi (Harbinger) — grant read-only access to transit logs for NET-88 and confirm network POC. Due Mar 11. (status: todo)
- A5: Sofia + Security — HSM/KMS review meeting invite + agenda. Scheduled Mar 12. (status: scheduled)
- A6: Priya + QA — run smoke generation test against canary node and post results to linked PR. Due Mar 17. (status: todo)

Decisions to capture:
- Use short-lived certs (7d) with client-side refresh token for long-running streams; implement naive refresh in agent first then harden in SDK. Owner: Sofia.
- Default to host-managed NVIDIA drivers for initial pilot to minimize container-level variance; revisit for multi-tenant setups. Owner: Ravi + Redwood eng.

Risks & mitigations: 
- Network instability could push pilot by 1 week. Mitigation: offer temporary cross-region proxy fallback to hosted endpoint (will increase per-token cost) — do we accept? (queue for scope decision)
- Driver/flavor mismatch: keep a spare node pool of a compatible older driver image to fall back for immediate capacity.

Prep checklist for the sync (what to bring to meeting):
- Aman: latest BGP trace + sample tcpdump (zipped).
- Priya: smoke test logs + exact image tag hash + repro steps.
- Sofia: NFS fio doc + KMS review bullet points + cert rotation proposal.
- Ravi: confirm network POC and provide transit log ACL details.

Next steps (after meeting):
- Update DEPLOY-321 with triage notes and link to PR #47.
- If network ACL access granted, schedule co-debug session within 48h.
- Re-run canary smoke and update readiness gate on Apr 1 if all green.

Misc notes / scratch ideas:
- Try using TLS session resumption for long-lived streams to reduce rehandshake costs when certs rotate.
- Consider a small caching proxy inside customer VPC for KV-cache warmup to reduce repeated cold starts across models.

-- Sofia
